source_evidence_manifest.record_scope: Official CLI, bbox streaming, uvx and minimum-transfer contract.
source_evidence_manifest.relevant_record_ids_or_excerpt: The official CLI supports overturemaps download --bbox=west,south,east,north -f geojsonseq --type=building. With a bbox only the minimum data is transferred, output is streamed, and uvx overturemaps can run the tool without a persistent install.

source_evidence_manifest.record_scope: Official package identity, version and console-script entry point.
source_evidence_manifest.relevant_record_ids_or_excerpt: Project overturemaps version 1.0.1 requires Python >=3.10, uses the MIT license, and registers the overturemaps console script as overturemaps.cli:cli.

source_evidence_manifest.record_scope: Official bbox validation and download command behavior.
source_evidence_manifest.relevant_record_ids_or_excerpt: The CLI validates bbox as xmin,ymin,xmax,ymax, requires output format and type, defaults to STAC filtering, writes to stdout when no output path is supplied, and calls record_batch_reader before streaming through the selected writer.

source_evidence_manifest.record_scope: Official STAC, anonymous S3 and bbox predicate-pushdown implementation.
source_evidence_manifest.relevant_record_ids_or_excerpt: The client reads the Overture STAC catalog and collections.parquet, selects intersecting assets, builds bbox overlap predicates, and uses an anonymous us-west-2 S3 filesystem to stream non-empty record batches.
